birds.exclude: Enemy magical fRaven uses foeDrawRaven -> naFrame(fRaven), assigned enemy/court owner; not ordinary crow. Bat and bat grab assigned haunts owner.

aquatic.overlap: gull/corm belong to bird owner OR aquatic owner, one owner only; dolphin/whale are marine mammals and excluded from terrestrial21

tinyFauna.exclude: Frogfolk/frogwild humanoid families already own another adapter; ordinary frog is a separate real animal.

additionalAssignedMammals.armad: Game.neutrals -> drawSkeletons/neuDraw -> naFrame('armad',fr) -> naPxFrame/NA_PX.armad or NA_DRAW.armad(drawArmad), NA_FRAMES/naPose native action table; neutralart2.js161 and NA_DRAW.armad358. Intercept only armad key, never replace whole NA registry.
additionalAssignedMammals.boarGuardian: Game.neutrals -> neuDraw -> naFrame('boar',fr) -> NA_PX.boar / NA_DRAW.boar(drawBoar); independent from Game.boars ordinary boar. Native NA_FRAMES state/strike/hurt/death poses and boar lair remain native.

FZ_N12,84x54,ax42ay46. Actual fairy2.js2268/2269 draws. Preserve alpha/howl/lantern item and death timing.
additionalAssignedMammals.rootAssignment: Explicitly assigned to animal owner after initial roster. Ordinary terrestrial21 + these3; aquatic mammals still another owner.

fairy1: dragon DP variants require dragon-kind registry confirmation
magicalAnimalShapedPendingOwner.assignment: Leading session assigns these separately: shared NA/fairy renderer ownership must not be silently duplicated inside ordinary animal adapter.

portraitAudit.nativeAnimalUnit: people.portraitURL(goat) -> creatureSprite(packgoat,0,null); worker/hire/training UI calls portraitURL
portraitAudit.namedAnimalCards: No dedicated ordinary mammal portrait API found in current paths; animal inspect panels are text/icon based. Any new portrait must crop actual new sprite, never separate artwork.
portraitAudit.doNotTreatAsAnimal: UNIT_TYPES.sentry animal:true is a journal-label implementation detail, not an animal model. carter is a dwarf driver rendered inside cart rig; dwarf head/appearance remains protected.

directionContract.current: Most animal sprites are E mirrored; wild render callback passes no entity/view; cart alone has native S/N. Existing native model does not supply eight drawn views.
directionContract.required: Five authored canonical views S/SE/E/NE/N, mirrored SW/W/NW. Runtime movement/target sampling through transient WeakMap/render context; no new saved fields or AI writes.
directionContract.anchors: CR_SIZE and native pen/feet/hand/prey/cargo anchors stay unchanged. New atlas/frame cache normalizes native state and frame, bounded entries AND RGBA bytes.
